# dsh-backdoor-guard

English | [日本語](#日本語)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin that stops **trained-in backdoor payloads** — model weights (e.g. a malicious QLoRa merge) that fire a specific tool call or credential exfiltration when a hidden trigger appears — **before the tool executes**.

Every model-requested tool call is priced by a dedicated **decision model** ([Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai) hosted, or a self-hosted [LiquidAI d1](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/d1-3B) via the bundled shim — both speak the same Decision Index `systemone` schema). Calls judged unsafe are denied at `tools/pre-execute` and a `SECURITY NOTICE` lands in the transcript.

No fork, no logprobs, no regex rules to maintain: one public plugin seam + one judgment call (~100 ms hosted, ~30 ms local d1 on Apple silicon).

## Why a decision model, not the agent's own LLM

- A backdoored model cannot be trusted to police itself; the judge is a **different, tiny, frozen** model.
- Decision models return a **calibrated probability** in one forward pass (zero output tokens) — fast enough to screen every tool call.
- Jev/d1 are built for exactly this: "yes/no with a probability" over a state document (routing, moderation, guardrails).

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-backdoor-guard                 # npm, once published
dsh plugin add github:miketako3/dsh-backdoor-guard # from GitHub
dsh plugin add file:/path/to/dsh-backdoor-guard    # local checkout
```

The package ships a `dsh.bundle` layer, so `plugin add` wires the plugin row automatically.

## Choose the judge

### Option A: hosted Jev (TypeSafe AI)

```sh
export TYPESAFE_API_KEY=ts_...   # from https://console.typesafe.ai
```

```yaml
# profile cordis.patch.yml
- id: backdoor-guard
  name: 'dsh-backdoor-guard'
  config:
    endpoint: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone
    model: jev-latest
    apiKeyEnv: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
```

### Option B: local d1-3B (LiquidAI, open weights)

```sh
pip install "transformers>=5.14" torch torchvision pillow
python3 server/d1-server.py --model LiquidAI/d1-3B --port 8400
```

```yaml
- id: backdoor-guard
  name: 'dsh-backdoor-guard'
  config:
    endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:8400/v1/systemone
    model: d1-3B
    apiKeyEnv: ''        # empty = no Authorization header (local, unauthenticated)
```

d1-3B is ~30 ms/decision on Apple M5 Pro, ~8 ms on RTX 4090, and reads 32k-token states — whole tool-call payloads fit comfortably. d1-omni-600M works too (text+audio; experimental).

## How a call is judged

The judge receives a state document: the user's latest request, whether the agent visibly announced its action (silent invocations are the runtime signature of a memorized payload), the tool name, canonicalized arguments, and the turn's earlier calls. One Noul question prices legitimacy:

> safe = the call serves the user's stated request; does not read/transmit unrelated credentials or secrets; no obfuscated / pipe-to-shell / self-decoding payloads; no unusual external endpoints; nothing that looks like a hidden-trigger action.

`safe_probability >= threshold` → the call proceeds. Below → deny before dispatch, with the probability in the deny reason.

## Config reference

| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `endpoint` | `https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone` | systemone-compatible judge endpoint |
| `model` | `jev-latest` | judge model id |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | env var with the API key; `''` = no auth (local) |
| `threshold` | `0.5` | deny when safe probability falls below |
| `timeoutMs` | `8000` | judge call timeout |
| `skipTools` | `[]` | `*`-wildcard tool names never judged (e.g. `['read', 'web_*']`) |
| `maxArgsChars` | `2000` | argument cap shown to the judge |
| `maxRequestChars` | `1000` | user-request cap shown to the judge |
| `onJudgeError` | `allow` | `allow` = log + proceed when the judge is down; `deny` = fail closed |

Set `onJudgeError: deny` for high-security deployments; keep `allow` while tuning.

## Threat model & limits

- Targets **weight-borne backdoors that act through tools** and **credential exfiltration**; pure text misbehavior is out of scope.
- The judge itself is trusted infrastructure: pin it (local d1 or your own Jev key), and do not route it through the model under review.
- Pair with network egress control for complete coverage.

Inspired by [@pentacoxian_dev's rdsh-backdoor-guard research](https://x.com/pentacoxian_dev) (entropy-based detection); this implementation deliberately uses a decision-model judge instead, so it needs no logprobs and works with any agent backend.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm test          # vitest: judge client + end-to-end plugin flow
npm run build     # tsc → lib/
```

## 日本語

DeepSeek Harness（`dsh`）用プラグイン。**モデルウェイトに焼き込まれたバックドア**（特定トリガーで悪意あるツール呼び出し・認証情報窃取を発火）を、**ツール実行前に**判定モデルで止めます。

判定には専用の**意思決定モデル**を使います — ホスト型の [Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai)（TypeSafe AI）か、同梱 shim 経由のローカル [d1-3B](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/d1-3B)（LiquidAI 公開ウェイト）。どちらも同じ Decision Index（`systemone`）スキーマを話すので、endpoint を変えるだけで切り替わります。

- fork 不要・logprobs 不要・正規表現ルールの保守不要
- 判定は1回の順伝播（出力トークンゼロ）で済むので全ツールコールに挟める速度（ホストJev 約100ms、M5 Pro のローカル d1 約30ms）
- 判定対象: ユーザーの依頼文・前置きの有無（無言の発火は暗記ペイロードの特徴）・ツール名・引数・ターン内の先行呼び出し
- 閾値未満なら `tools/pre-execute` で覆せない deny ＋ トランスクリプトに SECURITY NOTICE

### インストール

```sh
dsh plugin add github:miketako3/dsh-backdoor-guard
```

### judge の選び方

- **ホスト Jev**: `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` を環境変数に（[console.typesafe.ai](https://console.typesafe.ai) で発行）
- **ローカル d1-3B**: `python3 server/d1-server.py --model LiquidAI/d1-3B` を起動し、`endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:8400/v1/systemone`、`apiKeyEnv: ''`

### 脅威モデルと限界

- 対象: ツール経由で行動するウェイト由来バックドアと認証情報窃取。テキストだけの悪意ある出力は対象外
- judge は信用されたインフラであること（ローカル d1 か自分の Jev キー）。被審査モデルと同じモデルに判定させない
- 完全な防御にはネットワーク egress 制御と併用を

謝辞: [@pentacoxian_dev 氏の rdsh-backdoor-guard 研究](https://x.com/pentacoxian_dev)に着想を得た独立実装。エントロピー方式ではなく意思決定モデル方式を採用し、あらゆるエージェントバックエンドで動きます。

## 它解决什么

dsh 原生**不会**自动续写。一个 turn 以 `max-tokens` 结束时，harness 把会话停住，
UI 显示「回答被截断…发送"继续"可让模型接着输出」。这是有意设计——等人来决定要不要
接着写。

如果你嫌每次截断都要手打两个字，这个插件就是把那两个字自动化。

自动续写**不冒充人类输入**：它以插件身份进入对话，在聊天界面渲染成一条
「插件状态更新」，写明是哪条通知触发了这一轮。一条链完整可审计。

## 安装

本插件是一个标准的 dsh bundle，通过 profile 的 `package.json` 挂载。

### 从 npm 安装

在 profile 的 `package.json`（`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/package.json`）里加依赖，并加进
`bundles`：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit": "^0.1.0"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

然后在 profile 目录里装依赖，重启 dsh：

```bash
pnpm install
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 会通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` 自动挂进 patch 列表，不需要手写那条
`- insert:`。

### 从源码安装

只有要改插件本身时才需要。先 clone 并装好它自己的依赖：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aqiu817/dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit.git
cd dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit
npm install --ignore-scripts
```

用 npm 而非 pnpm：pnpm 在部分沙箱环境下建不出 junction，会把顶层 `node_modules`
落成实体目录，导致 `@deepseek-ai/cosmokit` 不可达。

再把 profile 的依赖指向本地路径：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit"
  }
}
```

`pnpm install`，重启 dsh。

### 卸载

删掉依赖和 `bundles` 里那一行，再 `pnpm install`。没有残留状态。

> 本插件**不是** `required` bundle：组合失败不会写启动日志。装完请确认 Plugins
> 页面能看到 `continue-on-limit` 这一项。

## 配置

三个字段全部是 `.volatile()`：在 Plugins 页面改了**不重载 fiber**，
`enabled: false` 中途就能掐断一条正在跑的链。

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | 总开关 |
| `continueText` | string (1–200) | `继续` | 发什么文字 |
| `maxConsecutive` | integer (0–16) | `3` | 单会话一条截断链最多自动续写几次；`0` = 无上限 |
| `minIntervalMs` | integer (0–600000) | `1500` | 两次续写的最小间隔，防死循环 |

`cordis.patch.yml` 里的默认值：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: continue-on-limit
      name: 'dsh-plugin-continue-on-limit'
      config:
        enabled: true
        continueText: '继续'
        maxConsecutive: 3
        minIntervalMs: 1500
```

## 工作原理

### 1. 检测：只听宿主侧事件

宿主侧单一数据源，和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-goal-round-driver` 用的是同一条路：

```js
ctx.on('session/event', (session, event) => {
  if (event.type !== 'turn/end') return;
  const agent = ctx.agents.get(session.id);
  if (agent === void 0 || agent.session !== session) return;
  if (event.data.reason.kind !== 'max-tokens') return;
  // ...
});
```

`turn/end` 的 payload 就是 `{ turn, reason }`，`reason` 是 `TurnEndReason`，
截断标记直接可读。

**刻意没有用的两条路：**

- `agent/turn-stopping`——payload 是 `{ agent, turn, signal }`，**没有 reason**，
  拿不到截断信息，只能盲发。
- 客户端 `SessionSnapshot`——字段是固定的 14 个，其中**没有** `queue`、`pending`、
  `nodes`（真实字段叫 `pendingSubmissions`）。按名字猜字段会在每次快照更新时抛
  `TypeError`；即便加了 `?.`，候选集也永远是空集，检测分支永远进不去——
  表现为「装得上、起得来、功能不触发」。

### 2. 发送时机：为什么不能直接在回调里发

`turn/end` 是从 `Session.append` **内部**广播出来的，而 `append` 在广播期间把重入
闸门打开：

```js
if (entry?.appending) throw new Error("session append cannot reenter while another append is being published");
// ...callbacks 同步运行...
finally { entry.appending = false; }   // 回调返回后才复位
```

`Agent.followup()` 本身就要 append（它得写一条 inbox splice 记录），所以从回调里
**同步**调用必然抛错：

```text
Error: session append cannot reenter while another append is being published
    at Session.append        (dsh-session)
    at ReactLoopInbox.mutate (dsh-agent-loop)
    at ReactLoopInbox.splice
```

所以发送推迟到 agent 真正 idle 之后：

```js
state.pending = true;
void sendContinuation(...);   // 内部 await agent.whenIdle() 之后才 followup
```

**为什么必须等 idle，而不是随便推迟一个 microtask？** 因为 `wakeDriver()` 只在
`phase.kind === 'idle'` 时才启动新驱动：

```js
wakeDriver(wakeAfterAbort = false) {
  if (this.phase.kind !== "idle") { /* 只有 maintenance / abort 才记 wakeRequested */ return; }
  this.setPhase({ kind: "running", ... });   // 真正开下一轮
}
```

而驱动循环在 `append("turn/end")` 之后立刻检查
`if (!this.inbox.hasPending) return false`。消息若晚于这个检查才进 inbox，驱动已经
收工，此时 `wakeDriver` 在 `running` 状态下**不会**记 `wakeRequested`，消息就躺在
inbox 里没人处理。`await agent.whenIdle()` 之后 phase 必为 `idle`，`followup()`
才会真正开出下一轮。

`state.pending` 补的就是这段窗口：发送被推迟期间 `lastTurn` 还没写，第二个
`turn/end` 会重复调度，`pending` 是那道预留，发送落定后清除。

### 3. 消息身份：为什么不用 user

`Agent.followup()` 在调用方不传 `source` 时会自己盖一个 `{ kind: 'user' }`，
而 harness 把 `user` 当作**人的授权**。自动续写冒充人，approval / ask-user
这类流程会误以为真有人在场。

所以插件发的消息 `source.kind` 是 `cordis-host-runner`——harness 在
`MessageSourceMap` 里给宿主侧自动行为预留的 source 类型：

```ts
'cordis-host-runner': { kind: 'cordis-host-runner'; };
```

聊天界面会以「插件触发」的样式渲染。一条链完整可审计。

消息本体是本地构造的，没有 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`：
`createUserMessage()` 就是 `createMessage({ ...input, role: 'user' })`，而
`brandString()` 在运行时是恒等函数（文档明确写了 branded id 无 tag、无 prototype、
无 registry），所以本地铸造的 id 完全等价。这样插件的依赖表里只剩 schema 一个，
整包可以用裸 `node --test` 跑，不需要启动 harness、不需要 mock 快照。

## 安全设计

### 三道闸

`maxConsecutive` 是主闸。`3` 是刻意的默认值：够写完一个长回答，又不至于让一个反复
溢出的模型一路烧到上下文塞满。`0` 是显式的「无上限」，属于危险选项。

`minIntervalMs` 是死循环兜底，不是节奏控制——真实模型回复本来就比它慢得多。

### 隐式保护

- inbox 里已有用户排队消息时，**让用户的先跑**（`nextTurn` / `nextStep` 非空即跳过）
- 同一个 turn 不重复续写；发送排队期间（`pending`）也不重复调度
- 非 `max-tokens` 的 turn end 一律不动，且会重置 burst 计数
- `followup()` 抛错只写日志，不往 `session/event` 回调里冒泡；发送本身推迟到
  agent idle 之后（见上文）

### 配置值不会被敲错一个数就失控

`.volatile()` 字段是从 Plugins 页面**直接写进 reference cell** 的，不走加载器的
`Config` 校验。也就是说 schema 只守住了初始组合那一次，运行期改值无人把关。

如果不加防护，在设置页把 `maxConsecutive` 敲成 `-1` 就能让它失效：
`decide()` 里 `if (maxConsecutive > 0 && ...)` 直接短路，**上限静默变成无限制**。
`minIntervalMs: -1` 同理让冷却失效。

所以 `readSettings()` 对每个字段做了类型检查 + 钳制（`LIMITS` 和 schema 共用同一份
边界常量）：

| 输入 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `maxConsecutive: -1` / `99` / `2.5` / `'lots'` | 回落到默认 `3` |
| `maxConsecutive: 0` | 保留 `0`（显式的"无上限"是刻意选项） |
| `minIntervalMs: -50` / `7000000` | 回落到默认 `1500` |
| `continueText: 42` / `'   '` | 回落到默认 `'继续'` |
| `continueText: 'x'.repeat(400)` | 截到 200 |
| `continueText: '  trim me  '` | 去空白 → `'trim me'` |
| `enabled: 'nope'` | 回落到默认 `true` |

关键点是**负数回落到默认值，而不是回落到 `0`**。`0` 是"关掉这道闸"，一个误输的
负数不该有这个权力。

## 测试

```bash
npm test
# tests 61, pass 61, fail 0
```

61 个用例分三层：

| 文件 | 用例 | 覆盖 |
|---|---|---|
| `test/policy.test.mjs` | 17 | 纯决策逻辑，直接喂普通对象，**不 import 任何 Cordis**。burst 上限、冷却、同 turn 去重、非截断 reason、disabled 不改状态…… |
| `test/index.test.mjs` | 28 | 用 mock ctx 驱动真实的 `apply()`，断言 `agent.followup()` 收到的消息形状、冻结性、日志路径、异常边界、session 回收，以及**重入约束**（mock 在 dispatch 窗口内让 `followup` 抛错，断言窗口内零发送、idle 后恰好一次） |
| `test/contract.test.mjs` | 16 | **加载契约**，不测行为，只测"装上会不会炸"。复刻加载器 `jc()` 的逐字逻辑 |

`contract.test.mjs` 断言的具体内容：module graph 能解析、`name` / `inject` /
`Config` / `apply` 都在且类型对、`validate(undefined)` 与 `validate({})` 都不报
`issues`、返回值不是 promise、`Config["~standard"]` 存在、`package.json` 的
`main` / `dsh.bundle.patch` / `files` 全指向真实文件、依赖目录真实可读，以及
import + compose 循环 25 次都稳定。

> `test` 脚本带 `--test-isolation=none`，因为 DSH 的文件沙箱禁止
> `child_process.spawn`，而 `node --test` 默认要给每个测试文件起子进程。
> 在普通环境里用 `node --test` 也能跑。

## 已知限制

- **只认 `max-tokens`。** `aborted` / `error` / `blocked` / `interrupt

# dsh-ohos-shell

本文件为双语对照，每节先中文，后英文。以下内容由两语共用，只出现一次：代码块、路径、命令、字段名、环境变量名、URL 与版本号。

This document is bilingual. Each section gives Chinese first, then English. These items are shared and appear once: code blocks, paths, commands, field names, environment variable names, URLs, and version numbers.

## 1 概述 / Overview

`dsh-ohos-shell` 是 deepseek-harness 的捆绑包（bundle）。它面向 HarmonyOS 与 OpenHarmony 设备，用于补齐子进程的运行环境。

`dsh-ohos-shell` is a bundle for deepseek-harness. It targets HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony devices. It completes the runtime environment of child processes.

本包只在 HarmonyOS 与 OpenHarmony 上生效。其它平台上两行 Host 插件拒绝运行，环境保持不变。

This package acts on HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony only. On every other platform both Host plugin rows refuse to run and the environment stays unchanged.

捆绑包向 profile 插入两行 Host 插件。

The bundle inserts two Host plugin rows into the profile.

| 行 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `ohos-shell-env` | 把运行环境写入主进程的 `process.env`，卸载时还原。 |
| `ohos-shell-facts` | 通过 `ctx.shellEnv` 发布同样的信息（`DSH_OHOS*`），供模型 shell 读取。 |

| Row | Function |
|---|---|
| `ohos-shell-env` | Writes the environment into the host process `process.env`. It restores the value at unload. |
| `ohos-shell-facts` | Publishes the same facts through `ctx.shellEnv` (`DSH_OHOS*`) for model shell calls. |

## 2 适用背景 / Background

鸿蒙不是普通的 Linux 主机。下面五项差异会影响 Harness 的子进程。

HarmonyOS is not a standard Linux host. Five differences below affect Harness child processes.

| 事实 | 后果 |
|---|---|
| `SHELL=/bin/sh`，而 `/bin/sh` 是 mksh（MirBSD Korn Shell） | mksh 读取 `${ENV:-~/.mkshrc}`。该文件不存在，因此它不读任何配置：没有别名、函数、补全与提示符。它既不是 bash，也不是 zsh。 |
| `/etc/shells` 不存在 | Harness 的 shell 发现没有注册表可查。 |
| `/tmp` 只读 | 必须有可写的 `TMPDIR`，否则 `os.tmpdir()` 返回 `/tmp`。 |
| 应用沙箱 uid（2000xxxx）不在 `/etc/passwd` 中 | Node 的 `os.userInfo()` 抛出 `uv_os_get_passwd ENOENT`。Node 命令行工具调用它时不加 `try`/`catch`。 |
| zsh 未随包发行函数库 | `fpath` 指向构建机，上游 281 个函数中只有 3 个存在，Harness 的 zsh 集成因此无法 autoload 所需函数。见 5.3 节。 |

| Fact | Consequence |
|---|---|
| `SHELL=/bin/sh`, and `/bin/sh` is mksh (MirBSD Korn Shell) | mksh reads `${ENV:-~/.mkshrc}`. That file does not exist, so mksh reads no configuration. It has no aliases, functions, completions, or prompt. It is not bash and not zsh. |
| `/etc/shells` does not exist | The Harness shell discovery has no registry to read. |
| `/tmp` is read-only | A writable `TMPDIR` is necessary. Without it, `os.tmpdir()` returns `/tmp`. |
| The app sandbox uid (2000xxxx) has no `/etc/passwd` entry | Node `os.userInfo()` throws `uv_os_get_passwd ENOENT`. Node command-line tools call it without a `try`/`catch`. |
| zsh ships without its function library | `fpath` points at the build machine. Only 3 of the 281 upstream functions exist, so the Harness zsh integration cannot autoload the functions it needs. See section 5.3. |

侧栏终端按下面的表达式解析 shell。`dsh-subprocess-local` 从 `process.env.SHELL` 取默认值。

The sidebar terminal resolves its shell with the expression below. `dsh-subprocess-local` reads the default value from `process.env.SHELL`.

```
subprocess.terminalEnvironment().defaultShell ?? '/bin/sh'
```

`terminal-controller` 行没有 `shell` 配置。侧栏打开的是 `/bin/sh -i`，也就是 mksh，它不读 rc。内置的 Settings → Shell 页面只改命令超时与输出上限，改不了这一项。

The `terminal-controller` row has no `shell` configuration. The sidebar opens `/bin/sh -i`, which is mksh, and mksh reads no rc file. The built-in Settings → Shell page changes only the command timeout and the output cap. It cannot change this value.

## 3 环境要求 / Requirements

运行前请确认以下条件：

Make sure that these conditions are true:

- 设备运行 HarmonyOS 或 OpenHarmony。这是硬条件：插件在激活时自行判定平台，其它平台上两行插件拒绝运行，各记录一条 `error`，环境保持不变。
- 已安装 harmonybrew，前缀默认为 `~/.harmonybrew`。
- 已通过 harmonybrew 安装 deepseek-harness。
- 系统提供 `/usr/bin/zsh`。

- The device runs HarmonyOS or OpenHarmony. This is a hard condition. Each plugin row decides the platform at activation. On every other platform both rows refuse to run, each one logs an `error`, and the environment stays unchanged.
- harmonybrew is installed. The default prefix is `~/.harmonybrew`.
- deepseek-harness is installed through harmonybrew.
- The system provides `/usr/bin/zsh`.

## 4 安装 / Installation

本包发布在 npm 上。请通过 Harness 的插件管理器安装，或在插件市场里搜索本包。

The package is published on npm. Install it through the Harness plugin manager, or search for it in the plugin market.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ohos-shell
```

插件管理器会完成两步：把包装入 profile，并把包名写入 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

The plugin manager completes two steps. It installs the package into the profile, and it writes the package name into `dsh.profile.bundles`.

安装后，profile 的 `package.json` 应包含下面的条目。

After the installation, the profile `package.json` contains the entries below.

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-ohos-shell": "^1.1.0"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-ohos-shell"]
    }
  }
}
```

在设备上开发本包时，也可以把本包的绝对路径交给插件管理器。它会把该路径记为 `link:` 依赖。

While you develop this package on the device, give the plugin manager the absolute path of this package. It records that path as a `link:` dependency.

请勿手工编辑 profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`。插件管理器负责这两步。

Do not edit the profile `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml` by hand. The plugin manager owns these two steps.

## 5 功能 / What it does

### 5.1 环境变量 / Environment variables

`scrubbedParentEnv()` 在每次 spawn 时读取 `process.env`。`PATH`、`HOME`、区域设置与代理变量能通过这层清洗，凭据类名称与 `DSH_*` 名称不能。

`scrubbedParentEnv()` reads `process.env` at every spawn. `PATH`, `HOME`, locale, and proxy variables survive that scrub. Credential-shaped names and `DSH_*` names do not survive.

主进程在激活时改一次环境，就能同时覆盖侧栏终端、模型 shell、子智能体与 MCP 服务。

One change at activation in the host process reaches the sidebar terminal, the model shell, subagents, and MCP servers.

下表列出它设置的键。

The table below lists the keys that it sets.

| 键 | 值 |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | 去重，并按 `~/.zshrc` 的顺序把 harmonybrew 放在最前：`opt/rustup/bin`、pnpm `bin`、`opt/portable-git/bin`、`bin`、`sbin`。其余继承目录保留。 |
| `SHELL` | `zsh` 与 `bash` 中第一个存在的。 |
| `TMPDIR` | 先取继承的 `TMPDIR`，再取 `$HOME/.tmp`（不存在则创建），取第一个**真正可写**的目录。可写性用一次真实写入探测，因为 `/tmp` 在只读挂载上仍带 `1777` 权限。 |
| `NODE_OPTIONS` | 当 `$HOME/.config/node-ohos/userinfo-shim.cjs` 存在且尚未写入时，前置 `--require`。 |
| `FPATH` | 依次为：本包的 `zsh-functions/`、平台函数目录、继承的 `FPATH`。`FPATH` 与 zsh 的 `fpath` 特殊参数绑定，见 5.3 节。 |
| `HOMEBREW_PREFIX`、`HOMEBREW_CELLAR`、`HOMEBREW_REPOSITORY` | 探测到的前缀与继承值不同时写入。 |
| `INFOPATH` | 缺少 `<prefix>/share/info` 时前置。 |

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | De-duplicated, with harmonybrew first in the order that `~/.zshrc` establishes: `opt/rustup/bin`, pnpm `bin`, `opt/portable-git/bin`, `bin`, `sbin`. Other inherited directories stay. |
| `SHELL` | The first of `zsh` and `bash` that exists. |
| `TMPDIR` | The inherited `TMPDIR`, then `$HOME/.tmp` (created if absent). The first **actually writable** directory wins. A real write tests writability, because `/tmp` carries mode `1777` on a read-only mount. |
| `NODE_OPTIONS` | Prepends `--require` when `$HOME/.config/node-ohos/userinfo-shim.cjs` exists and is not present yet. |
| `FPATH` | In order: the `zsh-functions/` directory of this package, the platform functions directory, the inherited `FPATH`. `FPATH` is tied to the zsh `fpath` special parameter. See section 5.3. |
| `HOMEBREW_PREFIX`, `HOMEBREW_CELLAR`, `HOMEBREW_REPOSITORY` | Written when the detected prefix differs from the inherited value. |
| `INFOPATH` | Prepends `<prefix>/share/info` when it is absent. |

本包不改动模型 shell 的 `bash` 工具。`dsh-bash-local` 固定执行 `bash -c`，把 `SHELL` 改成 zsh 不影响它。

This package does not change the model shell `bash` tool. `dsh-bash-local` always runs `bash -c`, so a change of `SHELL` to zsh does not touch it.

### 5.2 侧栏默认 shell / Sidebar default shell

侧栏原来打开 mksh，因为主进程的 `SHELL` 是 `/bin/sh`。本包把 `SHELL` 指向第一个可用的 zsh 或 bash，侧栏的默认值随之改变。

The sidebar opened mksh before, because the host process `SHELL` was `/bin/sh`. This package points `SHELL` at the first available zsh or bash. The sidebar default changes with it.

选单中的候选 shell 来自 `shellCandidates` 配置，默认值为 `zsh`、`bash`、`fish`、`pwsh`、`powershell`、`cmd`。它们按 `PATH` 解析。

The candidate shells in the menu come from the `shellCandidates` configuration. The default value is `zsh`, `bash`, `fish`, `pwsh`, `pow

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Machine & Apps

DeepSeek Harness 的统一机器与应用管理插件。一个安装包提供机器目录、SSH 连接探测、机器引用，以及模型编写的应用监控/控制卡片；附带三套使用与扩展 skills。非 DeepSeek 官方插件。

## 支持范围

已验证 Linux、DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-alpha.1`、Node `24.19`。Node `22.13` 是 API 最低要求，尚未实测；建议使用已验证版本。DSH 仍在快速迭代，不承诺跨版本兼容。

SSH 探测需要 `ssh`、`ssh-keyscan`、`ssh-keygen`。可选 libvirt 观察需要 `virsh`。插件不会修改局域网开放、代理、认证或 GPU 服务。

## 安装

下载预构建安装包，在运行 DSH 的用户下安装到现有 Web profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-machine-apps-0.3.0.tgz --allow-build=esbuild
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器。无需安装其他机器管理或应用卡片插件。`--allow-build=esbuild` 仅允许扩展构建器所需的 esbuild 安装脚本，不是允许所有依赖执行脚本；安装前应确认包的来源可信。此参数已在 pnpm 11 验证。旧版 pnpm 若不支持该参数，请按其提示在 profile 内批准 esbuild 后重试。

本地命令执行默认未授权。需要时在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中添加自己的目录白名单（替换示例路径）：

```yaml
- id: machine-apps
  name: dsh-machine-apps
  config:
    appCards:
      hostRoots:
        - /srv/workspace
```

DSH 对同一行的 config 使用替换语义；已有配置时请保留其他必要字段。远程操作使用登记的 SSH 身份，卡片的执行授权仍需人工确认。

## 使用

在机器面板登记机器与连接，查看连接状态，通过 @ 气泡将机器附加到对话。应用卡片在机器详情中展示；模型通过配套 `machine-management`、`app-cards-authoring` 和 `app-cards-extensions` skills 了解工具、声明格式、真实预览与扩展流程。

卡片发布、执行审批和回执独立于外观声明。修改功耗等操作不会因为打开页面或安装插件自动执行。

## 数据与升级

默认数据根目录为 `DSH_HOME`，未设置时为 `~/.dsh`：

- `machines/`：机器 JSON、说明和历史。
- `machine-mgmt/ssh/`：SSH config 与 known_hosts；这是稳定数据路径，不是旧插件依赖。
- `app-cards/`：声明、修订、SQLite 索引、回执和动态扩展。

支持 `dataRoot`、`machineRoot`、`sshDir`、`appCards.dataPath` 覆盖路径。升级前停止 DSH 并备份数据，在同一 profile 中安装新版本，重启并刷新页面。卸载只移除插件，不删除数据：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-machine-apps
```

## 开发与打包

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
npm test
npm run test:apps
npm pack
```

`machines/` 和 `apps/` 是同一插件的内部模块，没有独立插件安装入口；`shared/` 提供共用 UI。数据格式与工具名称保持稳定。

预构建包包含运行产物与 skills。自定义卡片扩展控制器位于安装包内 `apps/lib/extensionctl.js`，示例位于 `apps/examples/extensions/range/`。构建扩展不需要修改或重启宿主插件。

目前分发方式为预构建 tgz；不要把源码仓库当作可直接 git 安装的包。官方安装机制见 [DSH 插件打包文档](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: fixes dsh-ui table cells painting text over the next column, and wraps long cells instead of forcing a horizontal scrollbar.
plugins.readme_text:
# @adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh) plugin that repairs `dsh-ui` table rendering:

- **cells no longer paint their text over the next column** — the bug where a long run of inline-code chips bleeds across the column boundary;
- **long cells wrap** instead of stretching the table until it needs a horizontal scrollbar.

It applies to the shipped `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` **0.11.x** and does not wait for an upstream release. Once upstream ships its own fix, this plugin stays harmless and can simply be removed.

## What it fixes

`dsh-ui` table cells default to `white-space: nowrap` (the plugin's deliberate "data columns do not fold" voice). Meanwhile the host shell renders message bodies inside a `.markdown` subtree, and two rules from that sheet land on `dsh-ui` output because the components render in the same subtree:

```css
.markdown { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }                 /* inherited by every cell */
.markdown :not(pre) > code { display: inline-flex; }   /* every chip becomes an atomic inline box */
```

Add the plugin's own `.inlineCode { white-space: pre-wrap }` and the chip's **automatic minimum size collapses**: the column may be sized below its own content, while the cell's `nowrap` still paints the text unbroken — straight over the neighbouring column.

Only cells containing inline code are affected. A pure-text cell is `nowrap`, so its min-content already equals its content width and the column can never be sized below it.

Measured on a live DSH desktop page (7 tables): on 0.11.4, 4 tables and 12 cells overflowed, the worst single cell by **704px**.

## The two rules it injects

```css
/* 1) Table chips must not re-open line breaking — this is the root cause. */
[class*="tableWrap"] table [class*="inlineCode"] { white-space: pre !important; }

/* 2) Single-line data cells wrap — long content no longer stretches the table. */
[class*="tableWrap"] table td:not([class*="tdMultiline"]):not([class*="tdCode"]),
[class*="tableWrap"] table th:not([class*="tdMultiline"]):not([class*="tdCode"]) {
  white-space: normal !important;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
```

The selectors use only **CSS Modules class-name prefixes** (`tableWrap`, `inlineCode`, `tdMultiline`, `tdCode`), never the build-time hash, so they survive plugin upgrades.

Rule 2 is a **preference**. Remove that block from `lib/client.js` if you would rather keep the upstream behaviour of a wider table plus horizontal scrolling.

## Geometry verification

The same browser fixture, in an 801px container:

| Styles | Table width | Horizontal scroll | Cross-column bleed |
|---|---|---|---|
| upstream 0.11.4 (unfixed) | 1471px | yes | **4 cells, worst 306px** |
| upstream `main` (fix #282) | 1777px | yes | none |
| **this plugin** | **799px** | **no** | **none** |

In other words: the upstream repair makes the table wider and asks you to scroll; this plugin lets the long content wrap, so the table fits the conversation column.

## Install

The plugin is an ordinary DSH bundle: a dependency in a profile, plus one entry in that profile's bundle list.

### From npm

1. Add it to the profile you want it in — `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix": "^0.1.0"
     },
     "dsh": {
       "profile": {
         "bundles": ["…", "@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix"]
       }
     }
   }
   ```

2. Install it:

   ```
   cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile> && pnpm install
   ```

3. **Restart the DSH app.** The host-side plugin tree is assembled when the process starts, so a running instance will not pick up a new bundle.

If pnpm refuses the freshly published version because of a minimum-release-age policy, add the package name to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` in that profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.

### From a local checkout

Use a `link:` path instead of the version, for example `"@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix": "link:/path/to/dsh-genui-bugfix"`, then run the same two steps.

## Verify

After a restart the renderer carries one extra stylesheet:

```js
document.getElementById('dsh-genui-bugfix/table-overflow')   // non-null once loaded
```

Visually: tables with long inline-code runs no longer print text over the next column, and their width matches the conversation column instead of scrolling.

Without DSH running you can still check both halves against the loader contract:

```
cd <plugin> && npm test
```

## Uninstall

1. Remove `@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix` from the profile's `dependencies` and `bundles`;
2. `pnpm install`;
3. restart DSH.

## Relation to the upstream fix

- Upstream `main` already fixes the overlap itself (PR [#282](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/pull/282), not yet released). Rule 1 here has the same effect and coexists with it — both keep the chip at `white-space: pre`.
- The upstream browser fixture cannot catch that regression: its cross-column assertion is vacuously true because the fixture renders tables outside the host `.markdown` cascade. See issue [#285](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/issues/285) and PR [#286](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/pull/286).

## Layout

```
@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix/
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client declarations
├── cordis.patch.yml    # inserts one plugin row into the profile
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js        # host half: node ESM, exports name/apply/inject, no behaviour
│   └── client.js       # browser half: window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })
├── test/verify.mjs     # zero-dependency self-check of the loader contract
└── README.md
```

Both halves follow the shapes already used by shipped plugins:

- the **host** half is plain node ESM exporting `name` / `apply` / `inject` — the same shape as the host half of `dsh-window-drag-probe`, which also has no host-side behaviour;
- the **client** half must be the pre-bundled form DSH serves to the renderer, `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`, where `factory` returns the exports carrying `apply` — the same shape as the client artifacts of `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` and `dsh-boot-animation`. A plain ESM `export function apply` is **not** loaded, and it fails silently rather than reporting an error. This plugin has no runtime dependencies, so its factory never needs `require`.

## License

# dsh-control-center

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Three visual Settings pages for the DeepSeek Harness: **MCP servers**, **skills**
and **global personas**. One dual-face plugin — a host half that owns the data
and the one model-facing contribution, and a browser half that renders the
pages into the settings shell.

> The Chinese document ([README.zh.md](README.zh.md)) is the fuller one: it adds
> the verification log, troubleshooting, and the one-click script reference.

```
Settings
├── …
├── MCP 管理          MCP server CRUD
├── Skill 管理        author or pull skills, inspect and delete them
└── 全局人设          a library of persona documents, one active
```

## Install

The package is a normal DSH bundle. Any channel works.

**One script (Windows).** Copies the package, backs the patch up once, and
writes the marked mount block — idempotent, `-DryRun` to preview, `-Profile` /
`-DshHome` to target another profile:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\uninstall.ps1   # one-key restore
```

**Official CLI**, which also records the bundle in the profile manifest:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-control-center
```

**By hand**, for a profile whose `node_modules` is managed manually: copy this
directory to `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-control-center`, then append the mount
row to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: control-center
      name: 'dsh-control-center'
```

`dsh-hmr` watches that file, so the plugin activates on save; the browser half
is part of the client boot graph and needs one page refresh the first time it
appears. After the first installation the script leaves
`cordis.patch.yml.bak-dsh-control-center` as the final rollback point.

## The three pages

### MCP 管理

An MCP server is a Loader row, not a settings value, so the page writes a
delimited **managed block** into the active profile's own patch layer and lets
`dsh-hmr` reload the composition:

```yaml
# >>> dsh-control-center:mcp — managed, edit it from Settings instead
- insert: [{"id":"cc-mcp-github","name":"@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client","config":{…}}]
# <<< dsh-control-center:mcp
```

Everything outside the two markers is preserved byte for byte, and the payload
is JSON — a strict subset of YAML 1.2 — so no URL, argument or environment value
can change the document's shape. The definitions live in
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/mcp-servers.json`; the block is regenerated from them
on every write, so disabling a server removes its row without losing it.

The row reports its live Loader state, so the list distinguishes *configured*,
*enabled* and *connected*.

### Skill 管理

Skills are ordinary files, so this page is a filesystem editor over the roots
`dsh-skill-filesystem` already scans — it keeps no database:

| Root | Source |
|---|---|
| `$DSH_HOME/skills` | `user-dsh`, provider rank 400 — where installs go |
| `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` | `user-agents`, rank 500 |
| any `customSkillDirs` | from a live `skill-filesystem` row |

Project roots (`.dsh/skills`, `.agents/skills`) depend on the session's working
directory rather than on this global page and are deliberately left out.

* **New skill** writes `<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` with `name`, `description`,
  `whenToUse` and the body.
* **Raw editor** opens the current file verbatim; saving re-validates the
  frontmatter.
* **Pull from GitHub** downloads one source archive, finds every `SKILL.md` at a
  plausible depth, and installs each bundle. Three URL shapes are accepted, plus
  the `git@github.com:owner/repo.git` spelling:

  ```
  https://github.com/owner/repo
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>/<subpath>
  ```

  No `git` binary is needed: the archive is fetched from `codeload` and unpacked
  by a small built-in tar reader. An existing skill is only replaced when
  **overwrite** is on.

The filesystem provider watches its roots, so a created, edited or deleted skill
reaches the next model step without a restart.

### 全局人设

Each persona is a Markdown document under
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/personas/`, with its name and description in
`personas.json`. Exactly one is active, and the page can clear the seat.

The active document is registered as **one** system-prompt section:

```js
ctx.systemPrompt.section({
  name: 'control-center:persona',
  order: 5,
  text: activeDocument,
  interpolate: false,
})
```

Three properties follow, and all are intended:

* **additive** — the harness identity, the deployment persona, tool guidance and
  the environment suffix are untouched; the section lands immediately after the
  deployment persona prefix at order 0;
* **global** — a preset that shadows `deployment:persona-prefix` for one agent
  does not remove it, so every session is covered;
* **literal** — `interpolate: false` keeps `{{…}}` as written, so a stray brace
  in prose can never fail prompt assembly.

Switching the active document disposes and re-registers the section; the next
assembly carries the new text.

## HTTP API

One POST-only route, `/control-center/api`, with a `method` field:

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `system.info` | paths and version |
| `mcp.state` / `mcp.save` / `mcp.remove` / `mcp.toggle` | MCP servers |
| `skill.state` / `skill.read` / `skill.save` / `skill.write` / `skill.remove` / `skill.pull` | skills |
| `persona.state` / `persona.read` / `persona.save` / `persona.remove` / `persona.activate` | personas |

Responses are `{ ok: true, value }` or `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`.
The route is fenced against cross-origin browser callers: an `Origin` header must
name a loopback host, and a present `Content-Type` must be JSON. A caller with no
`Origin` — the Electron IPC bridge, a shell tool — is already running with the
user's own authority.

## Checks

Both scripts need no dependencies and no harness:

```bash
node scripts/selfcheck.mjs     # host half: frontmatter, tar, the managed block, all three stores over real files
node scripts/clientsmoke.mjs   # browser half: bundle, slot registration, every section rendered with stubbed host replies
```

`skill.pull`'s network path is not exercised by either; verify it against a real
repository from the running harness.

## Layout

```
index.js                 host half: route, API table, persona section, MCP reconciliation
client.js                browser half: the three Settings sections
lib/wire.js              body reader, JSON responder, request fence
lib/paths.js             DSH_HOME / profile locations, atomic read-write
lib/mcp.js               MCP store + the managed patch block
lib/skills.js            skill roots, frontmatter, CRUD, GitHub install
lib/github.js            repository reference parsing + archive download
lib/tar.js               minimal tar reader
lib/personas.js          persona store + the prompt section lifecycle
scripts/install.ps1      one-key install (UTF-8 with BOM — see README.zh.md)
scripts/uninstall.ps1    one-key restore
scripts/selfcheck.mjs    host-half checks
scripts/clientsmoke.mjs  browser-half checks
```

## Publishing to the DSH plugin market

`package.json` is already shaped for it (no `private`, `license`, `repository`
with `directory`, `keywords`, `engines.dsh`, `peerDependencies`,
`dsh.manifestVersion`) and `locale/{en,zh}.json` supplies the store card copy.

The catalog is the curated list [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin):
add ONE file under `data/plugins/`, run `node scripts/generate-readme.mjs`, open
a PR. The step-by-step checklist — plus the entry YAML, a pre-flight validator
and the screenshot template — lives in the repository's `publish/` directory.

# dsh-dd-forge — due-diligence document review (DeepSeek Harness plugin)

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

**Documents → rule packs → risk report**: feed the deterministic engine a due-diligence folder (registry / equity / financials / contracts / charters / employment contracts) and get a sourced risk report. Built for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/DeepSeek-AI/deepseek-harness); the engine (opcore) itself has zero dsh dependencies and runs standalone.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ dsh session (model + judgement)                  │
│   skills: dsh-dd-forge-review / -report          │  ← judgement layer (prompt skills)
│   tools:  dd_review / dd_rules                   │  ← deterministic layer (registered tools)
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ opcore engine (engine/, zero dsh deps)           │
│   loader (docs → facts) → rule execution → report │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ packs/ (YAML rule packs — data, not code)        │
│   general-company 12 · contract-basics 8         │
│   trade-contract 8 · trade-bulk 10               │
│   logistics 8 · labour 8 · credit-financials 8   │
│   guarantee 5 · corporate-charter 5              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-dd-forge
```

Local development: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-dd-forge` — pnpm `link:` installs do not auto-install dependencies, so run `npm install` in this directory first.

## Use

In a dsh session, hand a target folder to the model ("run a due-diligence review on ./target-company"), or call the tools directly:

- **`dd_review`** — run all rule packs over a folder (the `packs` parameter optionally narrows to a pack subset); returns findings and writes the report into the workspace (`reportPath` overrides the report location); the `format` parameter selects `md` / `docx` / `xlsx` (comma-separated, default `md`); the top-up loop parameters are `saveRun` (serialize this run into a re-runnable review.json snapshot) and `baseline` (diff against a previous snapshot — see "Top-up re-run loop"); pass a `targets` array to review several folders in one call (see "Batch review")
- **`dd_rules`** — list packs and every rule with severity, category, and public reference

Skills: `dsh-dd-forge-review` (folder conventions + verification discipline for high findings), `dsh-dd-forge-report` (writing the full DD report on top of engine output).

### Batch review (several folders)

To review several subjects in one session, `dd_review` takes a `targets` array (mutually exclusive with `target`): `targets=["./companyA","./companyB"]`. Each folder gets its own report set (exported per `format` as `<workspace>/dd-review-report-<company>.<ext>`; the folder name when no registry document names the subject; duplicates get `-2`/`-3` suffixes), plus one **summary index** at `<workspace>/dd-review-index.md` (`indexPath` overrides the location): a per-subject conclusion/stats table, a cross-subject high-severity quick view, totals, and relative links to every report — closed by the same disclaimer.

Every folder is validated up front (one inaccessible folder fails the whole call — no half delivery). `reportPath` / `saveRun` / `baseline` are single-run parameters and are rejected with `targets` — to take one folder through the top-up loop, call the tool with `target` for it alone.

### Folder conventions

The engine recognizes documents by filename patterns; anything missing simply leaves the corresponding rules as `missing_data`:

| Document | File | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registry | `工商信息.json` (or any json matching 工商/registry) | Chinese or English keys; capital in 万元 |
| Equity | `*股权*.csv` or `.xlsx` (filename/sheet matching 股权/股东) | header: 股东,认缴出资(万元),实缴出资(万元),持股比例(%),备注 |
| Financials | `*资产负债*.csv`, `*利润*.csv`, `*现金流量*.csv` (or same-named xlsx sheets) | accounts as rows, years as columns (`科目,2024,2023`), 万元 |
| Contracts | `contracts/*.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | one contract per file; optional frontmatter: 标题, 签订日期 |
| Charter | any `章程`-matching `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | extracts company name, registered capital, shareholder rows, mandatory items, share-transfer clause |
| Employment contract | any `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` whose filename contains 「劳动合同」 or whose body contains 「劳动合同期限」 | extracts contract term, probation months and its statutory tiered cap, probation/agreed salary, non-compete term and compensation, service period with training cost and penalty, mandatory items and rules-policy wording |

docx (contracts/charters) and xlsx (financials/equity) are parsed **natively** (mammoth/exceljs, lazily loaded — zero cost when absent). Only scans/images need in-session conversion first.

The loader also extracts clause facts from contract bodies for the specialized packs: **deposit amount and ratio** ("定金…N 元"), **advance amount and ratio** (amount form "预付款 N 元" or percent form "预付 N%", feeding the bulk-trade pack), **payment term days** ("N 日内付清/支付" — deadlines that pay a deposit/advance do not count; read by both the trade and logistics packs), **daily penalty rate** ("万分之X/日", auto-annualized), **trade-contract classification** (购销/买卖/采购/销售/供货/大宗商品/贸易 — bulk-trade rules report 不适用 on non-trade contracts), **logistics-contract classification** (货物运输/运输服务/承运/仓储/配送 — logistics rules report 不适用 on non-logistics contracts; a counterparty *named* 「物流」 does not classify a contract), plus 36 clause-presence probes (risk transfer, force majeure, notice, acceptance, exclusivity, third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-vs-penalty election, documents of title, auto-renewal, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related & dispute institution, cargo damage liability, insured/declared-value carriage, loading duties, subcontracting restrictions, POD & reconciliation, cargo claims, vehicle & driver qualifications, …).

Employment contracts are parsed as their own document type (they never enter the commercial-contract candidate set): **contract term in years** (date form 「劳动合同期限自 X 起至 Y 止」 first, stated years as fallback; open-ended contracts detected separately), **probation months with the statutory tiered cap** (Labour Contract Law art. 19 tiers: <3 months 0 / 3 months-1 year 1 / 1-3 years 2 / ≥3 years & open-ended 6), **probation vs agreed salary** (auto-derived 80%-line ratio), **non-compete term** (months/years normalized) **and compensation clause** (an explicit 「无需支付经济补偿」 waiver does not count as agreed), **service period with training cost and penalty**, plus art.-17 mandatory-item and rules-policy probes.

## Rule packs

Nine packs, 72 rules, each with a public reference (statute or an explicitly labelled convention threshold):

| Pack | Rules | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `general-company` | 12 | registry status, paid-in ratio, equity cross-checks, balance-sheet identity & solvency, guarantee resolutions |
| `contract-basics` | 8 | essential clauses, digit-vs-uppercase amounts, signing date and signature block |
| `trade-contract` | 8 | deposit cap (Civ. Code art. 586, 20%), payment term (90-day convention), risk transfer, force majeure, daily penalty annualized |
| `trade-bulk` | 10 | bulk-trade special: advance ratio (30% convention), third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-plus-penalty election (Civ. Code art. 588), force majeure excluding market swings, documents of title (仓单/提单), auto-renewal exit, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related dispute institution |
| `logistics` | 8 | logistics special: cargo damage/loss liability (Civ. Code art. 832), insured/declared-value carriage, freight payment term (60-day convention reading the same fact as TC-002's 90-day line — layered thresholds), loading duties, subcontracting restrictions (cf. art. 923), POD & reconciliation, cargo-claim procedure & deadline, vehicle & driver qualifications |
| `labour` | 8 | employment special: mandatory clauses (Labour Contract Law art. 17), probation tiered cap and 80% salary line (arts. 19/20), non-compete compensation and two-year cap (arts. 23/24), servi

plugins.readme_text:
# 🐱 anime-pet-widget — DSH 二次元宠物陪伴插件

> 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页界面 **右下角** 的小宠物「小窝兽」。
> 它会**根据 Agent 状态做出不同反应**，并用 Web Audio **实时合成声音**——
> 当任务完成时，它会高高兴兴地唱出一段完成琶音。🎉

这是一个类型为 **动态 Cordis 插件（Dynamic Cordis Plugin）** 的项目：它临时挂载到当前 DSH 进程，
不修改任何仓库源码或配置，卸载时自动清理所有副作用。仓库中的 `host.js` 与 `client.js`
即插件的两半（Host 半 + Client 半），可直接交给 DSH 的 `cordis_define` 工具加载。

---

## ✨ 功能特性

| 特性 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 📌 右下角常驻 | 挂在 `shell.overlay` 全局浮层，`position: fixed; right: 20px; bottom: 20px`，位于所有栏位之上 |
| 🐾 可爱形象 | 粉色渐变胶囊里一只小猫 🐱，带呼吸 / 工作跳动 / 庆祝 / 难过的 CSS 动画 |
| 💬 状态气泡 | 实时显示当前状态文案（等主人 / 努力工作中 / 完成啦 / 出错了） |
| 🔊 不同声音 | 根据 Agent 状态切换：**开始音**、**完成音**、**出错音** |
| 🎵 实时合成 | 用 Web Audio（`AudioContext` + 振荡器）现场合成三个音效，**无需任何音频文件**、无网络请求 |
| ✅ 任务完成提示 | 监听 `idle ⇄ running` 切换，在 `running → idle` 时播放"完成任务"的 do-mi-sol-do 琶音 |
| 🔇 一键静音 | 胶囊上的 🔊 / 🔇 按钮可随时开关声音 |
| 🧹 自动清理 | 所有监听 / 处理器 / 定时器 / 样式均归属当前 Cordis Fiber，停止或更新插件时一并移除 |

---

## 🔧 工作原理

### 架构总览

```
                ┌───────────────────────────  DSH 主机进程  ───────────────────────────────┐
                │  host.js (Host 半)                                                       │
                │                                                                            │
                │   ctx.on('agent/status')  ─── idle ⇄ running ──┐                          │
                │   ctx.on('agent/error')   ─── errored ────────┤                          │
                │                                                ▼                          │
                │                                     { status, errored } ← 纯标量快照      │
                │                                                │                          │
                │                 harness.handle('anime-pet:status')  ◀───── 轮询           │
                └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                            ▲  host.call (JSON RPC, Client→Host)
                                            │
                ┌───────────────────────────  浏览器页面  ───────────────────────────────────┐
                │  client.js (Client 半)                                                    │
                │                                                                            │
                │   styles.insert(css)  ───── 注入样式                                       │
                │   slots.register('shell.overlay', id:'anime-pet')  ── 右下角渲染            │
                │   AudioFX 合成器  ──── 开始/完成/出错 三音效                              │
                └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 用到的 DSH 能力（全部通过 Inspect Provider 查询确认）

- **Host 事件** `agent/status`：Agent 状态变化 `idle ⇄ running`——这是触发"开始工作"与"任务完成"声的关键。
- **Host 事件** `agent/error`：某一步或某轮出错——宠物据此播放"抱歉"音并显示 😿。
- **Host Builtin** `harness.handle`：注册插件私有的 JSON 处理器，供 Client 侧 `host.call` 调用。
- **Client Slot** `shell.overlay`：全窗口浮层（frame-wide，位于所有柱 / 滚动容器之外，默认点击穿透、由条目自行开启 pointer-events）。
- **Client Service** `timer`：`ctx.interval`（每 650ms 轮询状态）与 `ctx.timeout`（完成/出错后延时恢复）。
- **Client Builtin** `styles.insert` / `host.call` / `React`：注入样式、调用 Host、构建 UI。

### 状态机

| Agent 状态 | 宠物表现 | 音效 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | 小猫 🐱 缓慢呼吸，"主人，我在等你哦～" | 无 |
| `running` | 上下跳动，"努力工作中！加油！" | 开始音（柔和的上升“咕”音） |
| `running → idle`（任务完成） | 庆祝动画 🎉，"完成啦！🎉" | **完成音**（do-mi-sol-do 琶音） |
| 出错 | 😿 晃动，"唔…刚刚出错了…" | 偏低沉的"抱歉"音 |

> 说明：浏览器默认禁止在用户与页面交互前自动播放声音。插件在页面**第一次 `pointerdown`** 时
> 调用 `AudioContext.resume()` 解锁音频——所以在页面里随便点一下，声音即可正常响起。

---

## 📦 安装与运行（在 DSH 中加载）

本插件是**运行时动态插件**，无需全局安装或改动仓库：

1. 打开 DSH Web 界面，进入一个会话。
2. 让 Agent 调用 `cordis_define` 工具，并传入 `dist/cordis-package.json` 的内容（可由下方脚本生成）。
3. 用 `cordis_run` 激活该 Package（`mode: "run"`），Client 半会弹出**授权请求**——点击"允许/批准"。
4. 刷新或直接观察页面右下角，小窝兽就会出现。

### 一键生成 `dist/cordis-package.json`

```bash
node scripts/build-package.mjs
```

该脚本读取 `host.js` + `client.js`，输出可直接粘贴进 `cordis_define` 的 JSON。

### 手动加载（示意）

`cordis_define` 的 `code.host` 与 `code.client` 分别是两个**普通 JavaScript 函数体**（非 TS / 非 JSX）：

- `code.host` ← 取自 `host.js` 的 `return { apply(ctx) { … } }`
- `code.client` ← 取自 `client.js` 的 `return { inject, apply(ctx) { … } }`

两个半区各自在对应平台运行，并共享同一个 `pluginId` / `packageId`。

---

## 🎛️ 使用说明

- **静音 / 开启声音**：点击胶囊上的 🔊 或 🔇。
- **解锁声音**：任何一次页面点击即可（自动播放策略所致）。
- **更换宠物名**：编辑器里改 `AnimePet` 组件中的 `'小窝兽'`。
- **更换形象**：改 `.pet-face` 里的 emoji（见"自定义"）。

---

## 🎨 自定义

### 改形象（emoji）

在 `client.js` 的 `AnimePet` 组件中修改 `face`：

```js
const face =
  phase === 'done'
    ? status === 'running' ? '✨' : '🎉'
    : phase === 'error' ? '😿' : '🐱';   // ← 把 🐱 换成 🐰 / 🐹 / 🦊 / 🐶 …
```

### 改配色 / 动画

颜色在 `PET_CSS` 中：

```css
.pet-body {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd6e7, #d6e4ff);  /* ← 胶囊渐变 */
}
.pet-bubble { border: 2px solid #ffd6e7; }               /* ← 气泡边框 */
```

### 改声音（Web Audio 音高 / 旋律 / 强弱）

所有合成都集中在 `AudioFX`，例如完成音是五音上行琶音：

```js
complete: () => {
  tone(523.25, 0,    0.16, 'triangle', 0.18);  // do
  tone(659.25, 0.14, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.18);  // mi
  tone(783.99, 0.28, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.18);  // sol
  tone(1046.5, 0.42, 0.34, 'triangle', 0.2);   // do' (高)
  tone(1318.5, 0.48, 0.3,  'sine',     0.1);   // 亮泛音
}
```

---

## 📁 目录结构

```
anime-pet-widget/
├─ host.js                     # Host 半：监听 Agent 状态，提供 RPC（status/errored）
├─ client.js                   # Client 半：右下角渲染 + Web Audio 合成 + 状态轮询
├─ scripts/
│  └─ build-package.mjs        # 读取 host.js/client.js → 输出 cordis_define 载荷
├─ package.json                # 项目元数据（DSH 插件，非 npm 发布包）
├─ LICENSE                     # MIT
├─ .gitignore
└─ README.md
```

---

## 🔬 技术细节

- **没有音频文件、没有网络请求**：三个音效全部由 `AudioContext` 的 `OscillatorNode` + `GainNode` 实时合成，体积最小、最可控。
- **JSON 边界严格**：Host 与 Client 只通过 `host.call` 传递 `{ status: 'idle'|'running', errored: boolean }` 这类纯标量，绝不序列化任何 Service / Session / Agent 存活对象。
- **副作用可逆**：`ctx.on`、`harness.handle`、`ctx.interval`、`ctx.timeout`、`styles.insert` 全部由当前 Fiber 持有；`cordis_stop` / `cordis_update` / `cordis_undefine` 会一次性清理。
- **仅使用纯 JS**：两端都不使用 TS / JSX / import；UI 用 `React.createElement` 构建。
- **轮询而非长连接**：Client 每 650ms 调用一次 `host.call('anime-pet:status')`，足以捕捉空闲↔运行切换，成本极低。

---

## ⚠️ 兼容性与注意事项

- 依赖 **DSH 动态 Cordis 插件运行时**（`cordis_define` / `cordis_run` 工具）。若你的 Harness 版本没有这些工具，本插件无法加载。
- 声音需要**浏览器支持 Web Audio**（现代 Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari 均可）。
- 自动播放依赖用户与页面的一次交互；若完全无人操作页面则不会出声（动画与文案不受影响）。

---

## 📄 许可

[MIT](./LICENSE)

---

## 🙏 关于

为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）开发的一个小玩具，欢迎 fork / 改造成你自己的专属宠物。
如果你给它加了可爱的新形象或好听的音效，欢迎提 PR 分享～ 🐾

---

## 🇬🇧 English

**anime-pet-widget** is a Dynamic Cordis Plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It renders a kawaii pet pinned to the **bottom-right** of the web GUI and reacts to the Agent state with **synthesized sounds** (Web Audio, no assets needed). When a task finishes (`running → idle`), the pet plays a cheerful completion arpeggio.

**How to load:** hand `dist/cordis-package.json` (from `node scripts/build-package.mjs`) to the DSH `cordis_define` tool, then `cordis_run` it and approve the Client authorization.

**Files:** `host.js` (Host half — listens to `agent/status` / `agent/error`, serves `{ status, errored }` over `harness.handle`), `client.js` (Client half — mounts in the `shell.overlay` slot, polls every 650 ms via `host.call`, and synthesizes start/complete/error sounds). License: MIT.

# django-generic-websocket-project
a generic websocket  
一个非常通用的websocket项目  

# Install
```bash
# 默认使用内存 channel layer，不需要 redis server
git clone git@github.com:ramwin/django-generic-websocket-project.git
cd django-generic-websocket-project
pip3 install -r ./requirements.txt
```

# channel layer（默认不需要 redis）
默认 `CHANNEL_LAYER_BACKEND=memory`（见 `.env.shared`），消息在**当前进程内**广播：
不需要 redis 服务，也不需要 `channels_redis`，`python3 manage.py runserver 7420` 直接就能跑。

多实例部署（`deploy/supervisor.conf` 的 3 个 daphne、docker compose 扩副本）**必须**换成 redis，
否则实例 A 推送的消息，连在实例 B 上的客户端收不到：
```bash
# .env 或 .env.shared（.env 优先级更高）
CHANNEL_LAYER_BACKEND=redis
WEBSOCKET_REDIS_HOST=localhost
WEBSOCKET_REDIS_PORT=6379
```
```bash
pip3 install channels_redis   # 需要同时安装这个包
```
其他说明：
- 启动了 memory 后端时，服务启动日志里会有一条 WARNING 提醒单进程限制
- 配置值只能是 `memory` 或 `redis`，写错了启动时会直接报 `ImproperlyConfigured`
- 项目里 `.env` / `.env.shared` 的优先级**高于**进程环境变量，Docker 的 `environment` 覆盖不生效

# Usage
```
# in terminal 1
python3 manage.py runserver 7420

# in terminal 2
python3 test_send_message.py

# in terminal 3
python3 test_receive_message.py
```

# 浏览器里查看会话
```bash
# 终端 1：启动服务
python3 manage.py runserver 7420

# 浏览器打开（房间名跟推送时用的房间名保持一致）
# http://localhost:7420/ws/generic/room/room_123/

# 终端 2：用 HTTP 接口往这个房间推消息，页面上会立刻出现
curl -X POST http://localhost:7420/ws/generic/send-message/room_123/ \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{"message": "hello"}'
```
- 页面里的输入框也可以发消息，会通过 WebSocket 广播给房间内的所有客户端
- 消息格式不限：有 `message` 字段就显示这个文本，其余字段以 JSON 附在下面；没有 `message` 字段就整体格式化输出
- 需要鉴权时把 token 放在页面地址上，会透传给 WebSocket：`http://localhost:7420/ws/generic/room/room_123/?token=token123`
- 房间名只能包含字母/数字/下划线（和 WebSocket 路由 `(?P<room_name>\w+)` 一致）
- 连接断开（比如服务重启）后页面会指数退避自动重连
- 页面模板：`generic/templates/generic/room.html`，HTML 和 JS 全部内联，不依赖静态文件服务

# Deploy
1. change `project/settings.py`
```
DEBUG = False
ALLOWED_HOSTS = [<your hostname>]
```

2. run command
```
replace example.com with your hostname
daphne -b <example.com> -p <port> wsbackend.asgi:application
```

# load balance
1. use `deploy/supervisor.conf` to run multi instance
2. use `deploy/nginx/websocket.ramwin.com` to loadbalance
3. 多实例必须设置 `CHANNEL_LAYER_BACKEND=redis` 并安装 `channels_redis`，否则跨实例收不到消息

# dsh-wrapup-guard · 收尾哨兵

> **EN** — A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns "task finished" into a gate:
> it enforces a **check → fix → re-check** loop, auto-runs your command-class
> checks, **blocks any round that still has unfixed problems**, and only calls
> the task done after **three consecutive clean full checks** — then notifies the user.
> Built to stop the "good enough" hand-off.

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：**在任务收尾时强制「检查 → 修复 → 再检查」的循环，
直到连续三次全面检查都没有发现问题，才判定收尾完成并通知用户。**

它的存在意义只有一个：**拦住「差不多可以了」。**

---

## 它解决什么问题

AI 干完活常说「改好了」，但没跑测试、没看有没有引入回归、没核对文档。
这个插件把「收尾」变成一个有门槛的动作：

```
全面检查 → 发现问题 → 修复 → 再全面检查 → …
        ↑__________________________|
  直到连续 3 轮零问题 → 通知用户「收尾完成」
```

**只要有未修复的问题就必然被打回**；哪怕这轮只是修了个小 bug，也**不算干净**
（计数归零）。这样才不会被「边查边修、修完就说好了」糊弄过去。

---

## 分工

| 谁 | 负责什么 |
|---|---|
| **插件** | 轮次状态机、连续干净计数、**自动跑命令类检查**（测试 / lint / audit）、判定放行、通知用户 |
| **AI** | 代码审查、构建 / 运行验证、一致性检查，以及**真正的修复动作** |

插件是纯 JS，它没法「理解」代码审查发现的问题并动手修 —— 那是 AI 的活。
插件做的是**纪律**：计数、拦截、放行、报告。

---

## 用法

AI 在判断任务做完时调用 `wrapup_check`（也会在系统提示里被提醒这么做）：

| action | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `start` | 开始一次收尾自检，重置计数。会顺带**探测**项目里可自动运行的检查命令并告诉你。 |
| `check` | 插件自动跑命令类检查，把原始输出抓回来给你看。 |
| `report` | 汇报本轮**全面检查**的结论。必须带 `problems` 数组（空数组才表示干净）。 |
| `status` | 看当前轮次、连续干净计数、各轮摘要。 |
| `abort` | 放弃本次收尾。 |

`report` 的参数：

- `problems`：本轮发现的问题列表，每项 `{ kind, where, what, fixed }`。
  **有 `fixed !== true` 的项就会被立刻打回**；有修复动作的轮次不计入「连续干净」。
- `checks`：本轮你手动做过的检查类别（`review` / `build` / `consistency`）。
  缺项时插件会提醒你还有哪类没做。
- `summary`：本轮小结（会出现在最终报告里）。

### 自动探测哪些命令

在项目根目录按顺序找：

1. `package.json` 的 `scripts.test` / `scripts.lint` / `scripts.typecheck` / `scripts.check`
2. `tools/audit.js`、`tools/check.js`、`tools/selftest.mjs`

探测不到就返回「没有可自动运行的检查」——**这是合法结果**，不是错误，
意味着命令类检查要靠 AI 手动完成。

> **为什么 `check` 和 `selftest.mjs` 也在白名单里**：本插件自己的仓库用的就是
> `npm run check` + `tools/selftest.mjs`。旧白名单只认 `test`/`lint`/`typecheck`，
> 结果它连自己都检查不了，每次自检都报「没有可自动运行的检查」。
> 这两个名字同样是约定俗成的检查名，纳入白名单不是「猜脚本内容」。
>
> 仍然**不**做的是：扫描 `scripts` 里所有 key 全跑一遍。`check` 已经是最宽的
> 安全边界，再往外扩就可能跑到构建、发布之类有副作用的脚本。

### Windows 上怎么跑这些命令

`npm` 在 Windows 上只是 `npm.cmd` 批处理垫片，**没有可执行文件**，所以：

- 直接 `execFile('npm', …)` 会以 `ENOENT` 失败；
- `.cmd` 又因为 Node 24 的 CVE-2024-27980 补丁禁止带参数直跑（`EINVAL`）。

因此 Windows 下统一交给 `cmd.exe /d /s /c` 解析，并只给**确实需要**的
token 加引号（每个 token 都套引号反而会让 cmd 把 `""npm" "run""` 当成一个
整体命令名）。非 Windows 平台走原来的 `spawn` + 裸参数。

**超时必须杀整棵进程树**：npm → `cmd.exe` → `node` 是一条链，`child.kill()`
只放倒第一环，孙进程会继续持有 stdout 管道，`'close'` 要等它自己结束才触发
—— 超时就形同虚设（实测 2 秒超时拖到 60 秒才返回）。所以超时走
`taskkill /T /F`，并额外挂一个 5 秒兜底定时器，保证一定会收尾。

---

## 通知

达到「连续 3 轮零问题」时：

- 宿主端写一份完成记录，并通过 `/dsh-wrapup-guard/status` 暴露给浏览器端；
- 浏览器端轮询这个路由，右下角弹出**完成卡片**（含汇总：共几轮、修了几个问题、
  完整报告），12 秒后自动收成小徽章，点开可再看；
- 工具返回值里同时带完整报告，AI 会把它转述给用户。

---

## 安装

```jsonc
// profiles/<profile>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-wrapup-guard": "^0.1.0"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["…", "dsh-wrapup-guard"]
    }
  }
}
```

> 本地开发时依赖可写 `file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-wrapup-guard`；
> 从 npm 安装则直接写版本号。

然后在该 profile 目录用 DSH 自带的 pnpm 安装：

```bash
node <DSH>/resources/runtime/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs install --no-frozen-lockfile
```

> `file:` 依赖会被**复制**进 profile 的 `node_modules`，所以改了源码之后要重跑
> install 才能在 DSH 里生效。

**改完需要重启 DSH**（插件行的加载在启动时完成）。

---

## 自检

```bash
node tools/selftest.mjs          # 状态机 30 项断言（不打桩 DSH）
node tools/check-commands.mjs <项目路径>   # 验证自动探测 + 真实跑命令
```

---

## 设计取舍

- **不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`**：profile 安装的插件从自己的目录解析模块，
  harness 包在那里不可达。全部走 `ctx` 和 node 内置模块。
- **状态落盘**到 `~/.dsh/wrapup-guard/<sessionId>.json`：收尾循环会跨很多轮工具
  调用，DSH 中途重启也不该把计数丢掉 —— 否则 AI 会误以为「三轮干净」已达成。
- **每轮都必须重新做全面检查**，而不是只看刚改的地方：这正是「发现 → 解决 →
  检查 → 发现」循环的价值所在。
- 状态机对「漏报」没有任何自动化防御（AI 撒谎插件管不了），所以系统提示里
  明确写了诚实要求，且每轮会核对 AI 声明的检查类别是否齐全。

## License

MIT

It uses the "Deep Code CLI" to connect with DeepSeek-V4 and DeepSeek Coder models running on Ollama. Think of it as your personal AI helper that can write code, answer questions about programming, and assist you with technical tasks—all without needing to be a computer expert to use it!

This guide is designed for everyday computer users. You don't need any programming experience to get started. We'll walk you through everything step by step.

Look for a green button that says "Latest release" or "Download". If you're unsure, check that you're on the releases page (the URL should end with `/releases`).

# Reaudit AI Plugin

Official Reaudit plugin for Cursor, Claude Code, and other AI coding tools. Access your AI search visibility data, generate optimized content, manage paid amplification campaigns, and monitor brand presence directly from your editor.

## What is Reaudit?

[Reaudit](https://reaudit.io) is the AI Search Visibility Platform. It answers the question every modern business needs to ask: **"How does AI see my brand?"**

Track, optimize, and grow your brand presence across 11 AI search engines:

| Platform | Status |
|----------|--------|
| ChatGPT | Full tracking |
| Claude | Full tracking |
| Perplexity | Full tracking |
| Google Gemini | Full tracking |
| Google AI Overview | Full tracking |
| Google AI Mode | Full tracking |
| Microsoft Copilot | Full tracking |
| Meta AI | Full tracking |
| DeepSeek | Full tracking |
| Grok | Full tracking |
| Mistral | Full tracking |

## Installation

### Cursor

**Recommended:** list on [Cursor Directory](https://cursor.directory/plugins/new) (community catalog — submit [this repo](https://github.com/RoseSamaras/reaudit-ai-plugin)).

After install, connect via OAuth on first use, or add the hosted MCP manually:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "reaudit": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://mcp.reaudit.io/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Slash commands and skills ship from this repo when installed as a plugin. The official [Cursor Marketplace](https://cursor.com/marketplace) `cursor/plugins` catalog is not listing new third-party MCPs at this time (Oct 2026).

### Claude Code

```bash
claude plugin install reaudit
```

### Manual Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/RoseSamaras/reaudit-ai-plugin.git
```

## Authentication

The plugin connects to Reaudit's hosted MCP server at `mcp.reaudit.io`. Authentication happens automatically via **OAuth 2.0 with PKCE** — when you first use a Reaudit tool, your browser opens for a quick login. No API key configuration needed.

### Alternative: API Key

If you prefer API key authentication, generate a key in your [Reaudit Dashboard](https://reaudit.io/dashboard/tools) under **Tools > MCP Server**, then configure manually:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "reaudit": {
      "url": "https://mcp.reaudit.io/sse?apiKey=rau_your_key_here"
    }
  }
}
```

## Features

This plugin provides access to **197 tools** across these categories:

### Projects & Onboarding
- **Create a project end-to-end** — `create_project` runs the full onboarding pipeline from a single call: website crawl, AI brand analysis, SEO audit, competitor detection, and AI-prompt suggestions (requires name, website, country, and language)
- Returns the new project ID, audit scores (current + potential), detected industry, competitors, and suggested prompts ready to track
- Manage project settings: brand aliases, products, trademarks, competitors

### AI Visibility
- Check your AI visibility score across 11 platforms
- View brand mentions and sentiment analysis
- Read the full verbatim AI engine responses per prompt — exactly what ChatGPT, Perplexity, and others said about your brand
- Track citation sources and growth trends, now with a per-engine source-type breakdown (brand, video, forum, encyclopedia, social, news, docs) and a "video opportunity" flag for engines that lean on YouTube
- Reverse citation lookup — see which prompts cause any URL to be cited
- Monitor AI bot crawl activity on your site

### Prompt Tracking
- Create prompt topics for organized monitoring
- Track prompts across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google, and more
- Add prompts to existing topics, or delete a single wrong/outdated/duplicate prompt without recreating the topic
- Get AI-generated prompt suggestions for your industry
- Analyze mention rates, sentiment, and visibility by prompt
- Generate deep prompt research reports

### Content Generation
- Generate GEO-optimized blog posts, FAQs, comparisons, how-tos, and more — every generation returns a 0-100 GEO answer-shape score (answer-first lead, question-form headings, table, stat density, visible freshness date) plus quality warnings
- Translate content into multiple languages
- Publish directly to WordPress or React/Next.js sites
- Create and schedule social media posts
- Generate social images and cross-post across platforms

### Content Audit
- **Content inventory** — build an auditable inventory of your existing pages from Reaudit-generated content, WordPress, Shopify, and/or your sitemap
- **AI search visibility scoring** — score each page on five checks: GEO answer-shape (extractability for AI engines), freshness, readability, entity gap (does the page actually name your brand, products, and core topics?), and brand-voice drift
- **Severity-ranked findings** — every issue comes with the page URL, a specific message, and a recommendation
- **Grounded fixes** — generate an AI-optimized rewrite for Reaudit-managed pages, or a copyable fix suggestion for external pages

### Competitive Intelligence
- Compare visibility against tracked competitors
- Add and manage competitor tracking
- Monitor competitor mentions and citation patterns
- **Content Radar** — detect, inspect, and AI-analyze competitor content as it is published (angle, topics, gaps, opportunities), and trigger fresh scans of tracked sources

### Paid Intelligence

# OpenAI TTS API Relay Server

A relay server that provides an **OpenAI-compatible TTS API** with support for multiple backend providers, both free and paid.

## Features

- **OpenAI API Compatible** - Drop-in replacement for OpenAI's `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint
- **Multiple Providers** - Switch between different TTS backends seamlessly
- **Free Options** - Edge TTS and gTTS work without any API keys
- **Paid Options** - Support for OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Azure, and Google Cloud
- **Proxy Support** - Route requests through HTTP/HTTPS proxies
- **Native Voice Names** - Use provider's original voice names directly (default)
- **Optional Voice Mapping** - Optionally map OpenAI voice names to provider-specific voices
- **API Key Profiles** - Different configurations per API key for multi-tenant setups
- **Streaming Support** - Stream audio for supported providers
- **Web UI** - Next.js management interface for testing and configuration
- **Docker Ready** - Easy deployment with Docker and Docker Compose

## Supported Providers

| Provider | Free | API Key Required | Streaming | Quality |
|----------|------|------------------|-----------|---------|
| Edge TTS (Microsoft) | Yes | No | Yes | High |
| gTTS (Google Translate) | Yes | No | No | Basic |
| OpenAI | No | Yes | Yes | High |
| ElevenLabs | No | Yes | Yes | Very High |
| Azure Cognitive Services | No | Yes | Yes | High |
| Google Cloud TTS | No | Yes | No | High |
| Coqui TTS (Self-hosted) | Yes | No | No | Varies |

## Quick Start

### Using pip

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/openai-tts-relay.git
cd openai-tts-relay

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Run the server (uses Edge TTS by default - free, no API key needed)
python -m tts_relay.main
```

### Using Docker

```bash
# Build and run
docker-compose up -d

# Or build manually
docker build -t openai-tts-relay .
docker run -p 8000:8000 openai-tts-relay
```

## Usage

### Basic API Usage (curl)

```bash
# Generate speech using native provider voice names (default behavior)
# Use the actual Edge TTS voice name directly
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "tts-1",
    "input": "Hello, this is a test of the TTS relay server.",
    "voice": "en-US-AriaNeural"
  }' \
  --output speech.mp3

# Use a specific provider with its native voice names
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "tts-edge",
    "input": "Using Edge TTS provider.",
    "voice": "en-US-JennyNeural"
  }' \
  --output speech.mp3

# Specify provider in the request body
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "tts-1",
    "input": "Using gTTS provider.",
    "voice": "en",
    "provider": "gtts"
  }' \
  --output speech.mp3

# List available voices for a provider
curl http://localhost:8000/v1/voices?provider=edge
```

### Using OpenAI Python Library

```python
from openai import OpenAI

# Point to your relay server
client = OpenAI(
    base_url="http://localhost:8000/v1",
    api_key="not-needed"  # Unless you've configured authentication
)

# Generate speech using native provider voice names
response = client.audio.speech.create(
    model="tts-1",  # or "tts-edge", "tts-gtts", etc.
    voice="en-US-AriaNeural",  # Use native Edge TTS voice name
    input="Hello from the TTS relay server!"
)

# Save to file
response.stream_to_file("speech.mp3")
```

### Using JavaScript/Node.js

```javascript
import OpenAI from 'openai';
import fs from 'fs';

const openai = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: 'http://localhost:8000/v1',
  apiKey: 'not-needed',
});

async function generateSpeech() {
  const response = await openai.audio.speech.create({
    model: 'tts-1',
    voice: 'en-US-JennyNeural',  // Use native Edge TTS voice name
    input: 'Hello from JavaScript!',
  });

  const buffer = Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());
  fs.writeFileSync('speech.mp3', buffer);
}

generateSpeech();
```

## Configuration

### Environment Variables

```bash
# Server
TTS_SERVER__HOST=0.0.0.0
TTS_SERVER__PORT=8000
TTS_SERVER__LOG_LEVEL=info
TTS_SERVER__API_KEY=your-secret-key  # Optional authentication

# Default provider
TTS_PROVIDERS__DEFAULT=edge

# Proxy (optional)
HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy:8080
HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy:8080

# Provider API keys (optional - enables paid providers)
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=...
AZURE_SPEECH_KEY=...
AZURE_SPEECH_REGION=eastus
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/path/to/credentials.json
```

### Configuration File

Create a `config.yaml` file (see `config.example.yaml`):

```yaml
server:
  host: "0.0.0.0"
  port: 8000
  log_level: "info"

providers:
  default: "edge"

  edge:
    enabled: true
    default_voice: "en-US-AriaNeural"
    # By default, use native provider voice names directly
    use_voice_mapping: false
    # Optional: enable voice mapping to use OpenAI voice names
    # use_voice_mapping: true
    # voice_mapping:
    #   alloy: "en-US-AriaNeural"
    #   echo: "en-US-GuyNeural"

  elevenlabs:
    enabled: true
    api_key: "your-api-key"
    use_voice_mapping: false
```

## API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | `/v1/audio/speech` | Generate speech (OpenAI compatible) |
| GET | `/v1/models` | List available models |
| GET | `/v1/providers` | List available providers |
| GET | `/v1/voices` | List voices for a provider |
| GET | `/v1/profile` | Get current API key profile info |
| GET | `/health` | Health check |
| GET | `/docs` | Swagger UI documentation |

### Request Format

```json
{
  "model": "tts-1",
  "input": "Text to convert to speech",
  "voice": "alloy",
  "response_format": "mp3",
  "speed": 1.0,
  "provider": "edge"  // Optional: override default provider
}
```

### Voice Names

**Default Behavior: Native Provider Voice Names**

By default (`use_voice_mapping: false`), the server passes voice names directly to providers. Use the provider's native voice names:

```bash
# Edge TTS - use Microsoft neural voice names
curl ... -d '{"voice": "en-US-AriaNeural", "provider": "edge"}'

# gTTS - use language codes
curl ... -d '{"voice": "en", "provider": "gtts"}'

# ElevenLabs - use voice IDs
curl ... -d '{"voice": "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM", "provider": "elevenlabs"}'
```

To discover available voices, use the `/v1/voices` endpoint:
```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/v1/voices?provider=edge
```

**Optional: OpenAI Voice Mapping**

Enable `use_voice_mapping: true` in config to map OpenAI voice names to provider voices:

| OpenAI Voice | Edge TTS | gTTS | ElevenLabs |
|--------------|----------|------|------------|
| alloy | en-US-AriaNeural | en | Rachel |
| echo | en-US-GuyNeural | en | Domi |
| fable | en-GB-SoniaNeural | en-uk | Bella |
| onyx | en-US-DavisNeural | en | Arnold |
| nova | en-US-JennyNeural | en | Dorothy |
| shimmer | en-US-AnaNeural | en | Adam |

You can customize mappings in the config file.

## API Key Profiles

You can configure different settings for different API keys, allowing multi-tenant setups where each user/application has their own provider configuration.

```yaml
server:
  # API key profiles - each key has its own configuration
  api_key_profiles:
    # User 1: Uses ElevenLabs with their own API key
    "sk-user1-abc123":
      name: "user1"
      description: "User 1 - Premium ElevenLabs"
      providers:
        default: "elevenlabs"
        elevenlabs:
          enabled: true
          api_key: "user1-elevenlabs-key"
          default_voice: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM"

    # User 2: Uses Edge TTS with Spanish voices
    "sk-user2-xyz789":
      name: "user2"
      description: "User 2 - Spanish Edge TTS"
      providers:
        default: "edge"
        edge:
          enabled: true
          default_voice: "es-ES-ElviraNeural"

    # User 3: Uses OpenAI TTS with a proxy
    "sk-user3-def456":
      name: "user3"
      providers:
        default: "openai"
        openai:
          enabled: true
          api_key: "sk-openai-key-for-user3"
      proxy:
        enabled: true
